parsed.why: Anti-discrimination and hate-crime laws exist but fail: 79% social-distance rejection, hate speech with impunity, bank denial, police non-investigation, and unremedied birth-sex prison isolation corroborated 2025; Pride now police-protected and courts void propaganda bans.

Same-sex conduct criminalised and actively enforced: 2023 mass arrests and convictions, police extortion, president's stoning remarks, no legal recognition or organisations, torture/extrajudicial-killing context, advocacy exiled. Outed visitor faces arrest with no recourse.

No criminalisation, cross-dressing legal, employment protections, decades of gender recognition and funded care; attackers of trans tourists and a beating officer were convicted. Exposure is diffuse transphobia and rhetoric, but courts demonstrably work for trans people.

No sodomy law, but May 2026 police raided an LGBTQ venue, detained ~30, extorted them and fabricated homosexuality charges; post-election persecution, no hate-crime or identity anti-discrimination law, no remedy. Society polls majority supportive.

Strong machinery: transphobia aggravating factor, hate-speech and conversion-therapy bans, ombudsman guidance. But unremedied birth-sex prison placement with isolation (2010–2025), border document questioning, and 64% reporting discrimination keep it below top tier.
